justification: This replication directly verified all sequence-based core claims (C1-C5) using the deposited GenBank records, matching plasmid lengths, CDS/ORF counts as annotated, and presence of the full epidermin/nukacin gene clusters. The structural basis of C3 (a large insertion in pNuk650 relative to pIVK45) is strongly confirmed, though the exact additional-ORFs count differs due to annotation-method dependence, reducing perfect agreement. Data availability (C6) is fully confirmed via successful retrieval of the stated accessions. Wet-lab antibacterial activity results were not reproduced, so the overall replication is partial despite high agreement on all testable computational claims.
